query:
select
 (select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.prosecdef and has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'execute')) anonymous_definer_functions,
 has_column_privilege('authenticated','public.profiles','is_super_admin','UPDATE') user_can_set_admin,
 has_column_privilege('authenticated','public.profiles','platform_role','UPDATE') user_can_set_platform_role,
 has_column_privilege('authenticated','public.profiles','full_name','UPDATE') user_can_edit_name,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.promote_account_facts(uuid,uuid)','EXECUTE') user_can_promote,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.reconcile_account_facts(uuid,uuid)','EXECUTE') user_can_reconcile,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.share_fiche(uuid,text,uuid,uuid,text)','EXECUTE') user_can_call_retired_sharing,
 pg_get_functiondef('public.is_super_admin_caller()'::regprocedure) admin_authority_definition

result.admin_authority_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_super_admin_caller()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.is_super_admin();
$function$
